template_data.headline_html: Five things federal certifications actually do.

items.title: Open set-aside doors
items.desc: Agencies reserve certain contracts for certified firms — you compete in a smaller, better pool.

items.title: Accelerate past performance
items.desc: Set-aside contracts are smaller and less competitive — fastest path to stacking first wins.

items.title: Create teaming leverage
items.desc: Primes seek certified subs to hit subcontracting goals. Your cert is their compliance solution.

items.title: They don't close deals
items.desc: A cert on a dormant Schedule stays dormant. The paperwork doesn't prospect for you.
